table: Financial Report, Government Financial Position, Cash and Other Monetary Assets
title: Operating cash calibration for the opening treasury
universe: Federal operating cash; excludes other monetary assets
limits: The two fiscal-year observations calibrate a fictional opening stock, not the cash on any particular game date. State and local calibration is not supplied by this source. This stock is not current-year revenue or an appropriation.

US.citation: Treasury FY 2025 Financial Report, Government Financial Position: operating cash was $871.9 billion in FY 2025 and $870.8 billion in FY 2024. https://fiscal.treasury.gov/accounting/us-financial-report/government-financial-position
US.estimatedFrom: Mean of FY 2024 and FY 2025 operating cash, with a once-per-world offset within those observations. Other monetary assets are excluded.

spread.citation: FY 2024 and FY 2025 operating cash in the same Treasury Financial Report; a two-year range, not a population distribution.
